priority: Measure native benefit and map selected capacity first. These are bounded fallback cuts if the implementation does not fit, not measured ALM savings.

ranked_cuts.name: Integrated destination-zero specialization
ranked_cuts.scope: New mesh engine plus its existing raw LOAD instantiation, generic default unchanged
evidence: phase10_load_alias.v:94 rejects mesh VTX end != count through unsupported_features; legacy VTX construction at91 also has end=count
geometry_mesh_task_ctrl.v:40-43 computes offered_dest; assignments76 and79 capture load_dest and create owned_mask with a variable destination shift
geometry_raw_load.v:41-46 validates dynamic dest and builds shifted incoming_mask, stores job_dest/job_mask
geometry_raw_load.v:83,110,118,164 adds job_dest to raw/scan/compute/attribute addresses
phase10_load_alias.v legacy non-mesh branch:246 drives raw .dest(5'd0)
ranked_cuts.proposal: Pass an integrated-only DEST_ZERO_ONLY parameter into task controller and wire frontend raw dest to literal0. Keep the same early malformed/nonzero-destination fallback. Generate owned mask with no second destination shift. Generic standalone path retains arbitrary dest.
ranked_cuts.benefit: Restores baseline constant propagation through destination state, range addition, 32-bit mask shift and downstream small address adders; potentially more useful than tiny counter cuts.
ranked_cuts.bits: At least controller/raw destination registers become constant; no credible ALM count without mapping.
tests: All existing command-shape/nonzero-destination negative tests retain rejection before raw START
Legacy partial app G_VTX still maps software slots separately and uses physical dest0
Exact raw-output and native full-frame oracle unchanged

ranked_cuts.name: Bypass duplicate scalar task context capture
ranked_cuts.proposal: Add default-on capture parameter to generic engine; integrated wrapper selects direct scalar inputs.
ranked_cuts.proof: Wrapper holds aspect/coefficient/ambient/diffuse/lighting/scales in registers and writes them only with write_idle=full_write&&!active&&!pending. Active ownership covers raw LOAD, preflight, validation and copy. The only mutable held-task uniforms are separate flags/U/V and do not feed this scalar context.
ranked_cuts.existing_optimization: Raw frontend already selects CAPTURE_CONTEXT(0); its own unused held-context registers are not additional savings.
tests: Context writes while pending/active must not alter numeric results
Generic engine default continues to allow callers to change scalar inputs after task acceptance

ranked_cuts.name: Bypass duplicate packet immutable-input capture
ranked_cuts.proposal: Default-on packet capture parameter; integrated instance uses used_mask/live_count/flags/U/V directly through completion.
ranked_cuts.proof: Task controller used_mask/live_count are immutable after whole-task preflight until ACK. Wrapper accepts uniforms only before validation starts; packet_busy remains set through validated hold and copy. After producer completion they may change, when no further packet input is consumed.
ranked_cuts.qualification: Source flags upper13 bits and UV subtraction upper11 bits each may already prune, hence135 source bits is not a net FF or ALM estimate. Keep list_mask, converted X/Y/W/depth/U/V/RGB, current indices and output progress.
tests: ARM pending behind an older queued packet
Cancellation/consumer reset and immediate next task

ranked_cuts.name: Share matrix initialization bitmap
ranked_cuts.proposal: Integrated engine consumes wrapper matrix_complete; generic engine retains own bitmap.
ranked_cuts.proof: Both integrated maps see the same16 accepted matrix writes and reset. Wrapper idle gating and engine task_ready gating coincide when those writes are possible.
tests: No matrix, partially initialized matrix, all16 writes

ranked_cuts.name: Exact narrower converter control/guard-sticky network
ranked_cuts.proposal: Replace integer/general shifts with bounded exponent cases and exact guard/sticky rounding while keeping all error/clamp behavior.
ranked_cuts.benefit: Potentially removes broad dynamic remainder/mask shifters. Synthesis can already narrow some source expressions; this is higher verification cost than capture bypass.
tests: Existing converter CPU oracle including ties, +/-zero, nonnormal inputs, overflow and depth clamps
Full scene-chain payload and native frame oracle

ranked_cuts.name: Optional new MMIO diagnostic readback pruning
ranked_cuts.proposal: Only if necessary, make new descriptor/uniform/completed-serial diagnostic readbacks optional in a documented trial configuration. Keep capability/status and exact clip/cull/input counts.
ranked_cuts.benefit: completed_serial32 exists solely for word0x2f readback. configuration has15 reserved bits and VTX has9 unused bits retained for full readback; removing readback may let those prune and shrink muxes. Do not claim all source registers disappear.
ranked_cuts.compatibility: This changes documented readback behavior; generic default must preserve ABI, and experiment configuration/receipt must explicitly state zero reads. Current app only reads status21,input2e,clip29,cull2a.
ranked_cuts.not_remove: clip/cull/input counts are used by gfx_mesh_finish for consistency and exact diagnostics, not optional unused telemetry.

possible_later_metadata_packing.proposal: After complete context validation, store19-bit flags and two16-bit tile origins (reconstruct <<3) rather than96 bits; preserve malformed full32-bit marker checks, including high/reserved/alignment bits.
possible_later_metadata_packing.qualification: Queue producer and head are different concurrent packets, and bridge marker may be a third; cannot merge these contexts. Generic queue currently accepts arbitrary metadata, so specialization requires explicit domain checks/parameter. Untextured raw offsets need canonicalization or preservation if generic ABI permits arbitrary unused values. Higher risk than direct capture bypass.
